resources.string: Connect RELYRA\'s shared HTTP/WebSocket/file clients to an external Tor SOCKS service such as Orbot. The local default is 127.0.0.1:9050. RELYRA does not bundle or start Tor, and bridge configuration stays in the Tor app.
Strict mode sends new OkHttp relay and file-server requests only through SOCKS. If Tor is unavailable, those requests fail closed. The built-in WebView is blocked while Tor proxy mode is enabled.
Warning: direct fallback is allowed when SOCKS is unreachable. This is not strict Tor routing and may expose your IP address.
Save settings and verify Tor route
Tor proxy is enabled. Run the Tor exit check before relying on it.
